name: Corrupting Joy: 365 Days
source:
In Corrupting Joy: 365 Days, you take control of Joy, an exemplary wife and mother, as she enters a labyrinth of temptations. Every day counts. Every choice chips away at her morality. Will you keep her secrets buried, or turn her life into a public spectacle of depravity?

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/cw/GM_GAME]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
在《腐化的欢乐：365天》中，你将控制乔伊，一位模范妻子和母亲，进入充满诱惑的迷宫。每一天都很重要。每一个选择都会削弱她的道德。你会隐藏她的秘密，还是将她的生活变成公开的堕落景象？

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/cw/GM_GAME]Patreon[/url]]
